name: 5dim_quality
title: 5Dim's mod - Quality
author: 5Dim
description:
Extends the quality ladder up to 10 levels to match 5Dim's tiered progression.
Adds Mythic, Ascended, Divine, Cosmic and Eternal qualities on top of the vanilla ones, recoloured with the 5Dim tier palette.
Requires 5dim_core and the Quality system.
